editorial:
You follow Jason, a Boston teen who lives and breathes old kung fu movies. When a pawnshop trip goes sideways, he grabs a golden staff and tumbles into ancient China. There he teams up with a drunken immortal, a silent monk, and a fierce young woman on a mission to free the Monkey King. It's a fun, colorful adventure that mixes fish-out-of-water comedy with classic martial arts fantasy, and it never takes itself too seriously.

The big draw is seeing Jackie Chan and Jet Li share the screen for the first time, and their fight scenes really deliver. The action is fast and playful, the scenery is gorgeous, and the story moves quickly from one set piece to the next. On the downside, the plot is simple and some effects look a little dated. Still, if you want a light, family-friendly martial arts romp, this is a great pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final battle, Jason and his friends defeat the Jade Warlord and free the Monkey King, who turns the warlord to stone. The Monkey King sends Jason back to present-day Boston with real kung fu skills. Jason stands up to the bullies who tormented him, then returns the golden staff to the pawnshop. The old shopkeeper smiles, hinting he is the Monkey King in disguise, proving the whole adventure was real.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves kung fu movies and lighthearted fantasy adventures.
